{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} {-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-} module SmartContract.CircuitBreaker where import Data.Text (Text) import qualified Data.Text as T import Data.Map.Strict (Map) import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime) import Data.IORef import GHC.Generics (Generic) import Network.Wai import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp (run) import Network.HTTP.Types import Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 (pack) import qualified Data.ByteString as BS -- Circuit breaker states data BreakerState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq, Generic) data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker { cbState :: BreakerState , cbFailures :: Int , cbThreshold :: Int , cbLastFailure :: Maybe UTCTime , cbCooldown :: Int -- seconds } deriving (Show, Generic) data ContractState = ContractState { csBalances :: Map Text Integer , csBreaker :: CircuitBreaker , csOwner :: Text , csFramePolicy :: FramePolicy , csTotalSupply :: Integer } deriving (Show, Generic) -- Frame embedding policy for the contract dashboard data FramePolicy = FramePolicy { fpAllowFrom :: [Text] , fpDenyAll :: Bool , fpSameOrigin :: Bool , fpInherit :: Bool } deriving (Show, Generic) -- Security headers configuration data SecurityHeaders = SecurityHeaders { shXFrameOptions :: Maybe Text , shContentSecurityPolicy :: Maybe Text , shStrictTransport :: Maybe Text } deriving (Show, Generic) -- Initialize default frame policy defaultFramePolicy :: FramePolicy defaultFramePolicy = FramePolicy { fpAllowFrom = [] , fpDenyAll = True , fpSameOrigin = False , fpInherit = False } -- Derive security headers from frame policy -- This function determines the X-Frame-Options header deriveSecurityHeaders :: FramePolicy -> SecurityHeaders deriveSecurityHeaders policy = SecurityHeaders { shXFrameOptions = computeFrameOption policy , shContentSecurityPolicy = computeCSP policy , shStrictTransport = Just "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" } -- Core logic: compute X-Frame-Options based on policy computeFrameOption :: FramePolicy -> Maybe Text computeFrameOption policy | fpInherit policy = Nothing -- inherit from parent context | fpDenyAll policy = Just "DENY" | fpSameOrigin policy = Just "SAMEORIGIN" | not (null (fpAllowFrom policy)) = Just $ "ALLOW-FROM " <> head (fpAllowFrom policy) | otherwise = Nothing -- Compute Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive computeCSP :: FramePolicy -> Maybe Text computeCSP policy | fpInherit policy = Nothing | fpDenyAll policy = Just "frame-ancestors 'none'" | fpSameOrigin policy = Just "frame-ancestors 'self'" | not (null (fpAllowFrom policy)) = Just $ "frame-ancestors " <> T.intercalate " " (fpAllowFrom policy) | otherwise = Nothing -- Circuit breaker transition logic tripBreaker :: CircuitBreaker -> UTCTime -> CircuitBreaker tripBreaker cb now = cb { cbState = if cbFailures cb + 1 >= cbThreshold cb then Open else cbState cb , cbFailures = cbFailures cb + 1 , cbLastFailure = Just now } resetBreaker :: CircuitBreaker -> CircuitBreaker resetBreaker cb = cb { cbState = Closed, cbFailures = 0, cbLastFailure = Nothing } -- When circuit breaker trips, we enter emergency mode -- Emergency mode changes the frame policy to allow monitoring dashboards emergencyFramePolicy :: FramePolicy emergencyFramePolicy = FramePolicy { fpAllowFrom = ["https://monitor.internal.corp"] , fpDenyAll = False , fpSameOrigin = False , fpInherit = True -- KEY: inherit flag takes precedence in deriveSecurityHeaders } -- Get effective frame policy based on circuit breaker state getEffectivePolicy :: ContractState -> FramePolicy getEffectivePolicy cs = case cbState (csBreaker cs) of Open -> emergencyFramePolicy HalfOpen -> emergencyFramePolicy Closed -> csFramePolicy cs -- Apply security headers to response applySecurityHeaders :: SecurityHeaders -> Response -> Response applySecurityHeaders headers resp = let addHeader name mval r = case mval of Nothing -> r Just v -> mapResponseHeaders ((name, encodeUtf8 v) :) r encodeUtf8 = BS.pack . map (fromIntegral . fromEnum) . T.unpack in addHeader "X-Frame-Options" (shXFrameOptions headers) $ addHeader "Content-Security-Policy" (shContentSecurityPolicy headers) $ addHeader "Strict-Transport-Security" (shStrictTransport headers) $ resp -- Contract execution endpoint contractApp :: IORef ContractState -> Application contractApp stateRef req respond = do state <- readIORef stateRef let effectivePolicy = getEffectivePolicy state secHeaders = deriveSecurityHeaders effectivePolicy baseResponse = responseLBS status200 [("Content-Type", "text/html")] (pack $ renderDashboard state) finalResponse = applySecurityHeaders secHeaders baseResponse respond finalResponse -- Render the contract dashboard (contains sensitive operations) renderDashboard :: ContractState -> String renderDashboard cs = unlines [ "Contract Dashboard" , "" , "

Smart Contract Circuit Breaker Dashboard

" , "

Breaker State: " ++ show (cbState (csBreaker cs)) ++ "

" , "

Total Supply: " ++ show (csTotalSupply cs) ++ "

" , "
" , " " , " " , " " , "

" , " " , "
" , "" ] -- Main entry point main :: IO () main = do let initialState = ContractState { csBalances = Map.fromList [("owner", 1000000)] , csBreaker = CircuitBreaker Closed 0 5 Nothing 60 , csOwner = "owner" , csFramePolicy = defaultFramePolicy , csTotalSupply = 1000000 } stateRef <- newIORef initialState putStrLn "Starting contract dashboard on port 8080" run 8080 (contractApp stateRef)
